200.description: Validated and scheduled for bounded best-effort forwarding; not durable storage or provider ingestion.

post.description: Validates a JSON batch and registers bounded best-effort forwarding. The 200 receipt does not imply durable storage or provider ingestion. Content-Type must be application/json. Ingress limits are owned by the edge.

200.description: Synchronous receipt for a validated report. It is not durable acceptance, provider ingestion, or issue creation.

post.description:
Receives one bounded, allowlisted failure report from a consent-controlled client invocation.

**Receipt.** A `200` response is a synchronous receipt: the report passed
validation and its forwarding was registered as bounded, best-effort
background work of the receiving invocation. The receipt is not durable
acceptance, provider ingestion, or issue creation, and the service stores
nothing. Forwarding may be dropped when a provider fails or the invocation's
background deadline passes; no exactly-once delivery is promised.

**Report identity.** Resubmitting the same report keeps its `eventId`. The
service carries that identity into the provider insert and event
identities, but provider deduplication is not an end-to-end guarantee.

**Declared fields only.** Only the declared, bounded fields are accepted.
A report with an undeclared field is refused with `400 invalid_request`,
and its `errors` entry points at the field. Reports identify a failure kind
and operation and may carry bounded request evidence, batch outcomes, operation history,
and AXM-owned source locations verified by the reporting build. They carry
no messages, raw stacks, arguments, absolute paths, source excerpts,
variables, or extension code.

DecodeErrorResponse.title: Decode Error Problem Details
DecodeErrorResponse.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details for a request that failed schema decoding; each `errors` entry points at one offending location.

TelemetryErrorReceipt.title: Telemetry Error Receipt
TelemetryErrorReceipt.description: Synchronous receipt for a validated report. It is not durable acceptance, provider ingestion, or issue creation.

eventId.description: Report identity, fresh per report and unchanged when the same report is resubmitted.

invocationId.description: Identity of the client process invocation that failed.

installationId.description: Random persisted installation identity; absent when the client could not load or create it.

activityId.description: Product activity correlation identity when the invocation started one.

command.description: Canonical command identity when known, for example `extensions install`. Never arguments.

phase.title: Failure Phase
phase.description: The invocation phase that settled with the failure: startup, workspace configuration, command execution, or output writing.

kind.description: Stable diagnostic identifier from the client's enumerated failure set.

category.description: AXM error category, for example `validation` or `network`.

class.title: Error Class
class.description: Classifies whether a failure is an AXM defect, a user-correctable failure, or an external dependency failure.

operation.description: Code-defined operation that failed, never arguments or paths.

handled.description: False when the failure is an unexpected defect rather than an expected error.

failure.title: Reported Failure
failure.description: Allowlisted diagnostic identity of one terminal failure.

TelemetryErrorReport.title: Telemetry Error Report
TelemetryErrorReport.description: One bounded, allowlisted report of a consent-controlled client invocation's terminal failure. It carries diagnostic identity, request correlation, bounded operation evidence, and build-verified AXM-owned source locations; never messages, raw stacks, arguments, absolute paths, source excerpts, or other free-form content.

TelemetryFailureFrame.description: A source location verified against the reporting AXM build. No absolute path, function text, source excerpt, variables, or extension code is carried.

TelemetryFailureRequest.description: Bounded evidence from the failed Registry request attempt. Request identity is correlation, never authorization or an idempotency key.

version.description: Released client version; development builds carry their build suffix here.

runtimeVersion.description: Version of the executing runtime, or `unknown`.

platform.description: Operating system platform identifier, for example `darwin`.

ci.description: Whether the client detected a continuous-integration host.

TelemetryReportingClient.title: Telemetry Reporting Client
TelemetryReportingClient.description: Bounded facts about the client build and host that reported a failure.

TelemetryEventsReceipt.description: Validated and scheduled for bounded best-effort forwarding; not durable storage or provider ingestion.

TelemetryEventsRequest.title: Telemetry Events Request
TelemetryEventsRequest.description: Request payload accepted by the telemetry events ingestion endpoint.

os.title: Operating System Context
os.description: Operating system metadata captured alongside telemetry.

runtime.title: Runtime Context
runtime.description: Language or process runtime metadata captured alongside telemetry.

device.title: Device Context
device.description: Device characteristics attached to telemetry submissions.

ide.title: IDE Context
ide.description: Editor or IDE metadata attached when telemetry originates from a development tool.

invocationId.description: Identity of the client process invocation that produced the batch; the same identity appears on that invocation's client error reports.

TelemetryContext.title: Telemetry Context
TelemetryContext.description: Shared environment metadata attached to analytics event batches.

TelemetryClientContext.title: Telemetry Client Context
TelemetryClientContext.description: Identifies the client emitting telemetry, including its name and version.

eventId.description: Producer-assigned event identity retained across delivery retries for downstream deduplication.

additionalProperties.title: User Property Value
additionalProperties.description: Telemetry user property value limited to JSON primitives or flat arrays of JSON primitives.

additionalProperties.title: User Property Value
additionalProperties.description: Telemetry user property value limited to JSON primitives or flat arrays of JSON primitives.

additionalProperties.title: User Property Value
additionalProperties.description: Telemetry user property value limited to JSON primitives or flat arrays of JSON primitives.

TelemetryEvent.title: Telemetry Event
TelemetryEvent.description: One analytics event captured by the AgentXM client or integration.

version.title: Version
version.description: A semver version like 1.0.0. Ranges are not allowed here.

SkillInstallEvent.description: One committed usable skill installation. Public coordinates are client assertions, not server-verified adoption.

ExtensionName.title: Extension Name
ExtensionName.description: The name of an extension — lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (e.g. my-skill).

AgentId.title: Agent ID
AgentId.description: Verified coding agent identifier in the capability catalog.

TelemetryMetaResponse.title: Telemetry Meta Response
TelemetryMetaResponse.description: Service metadata and documentation entrypoints exposed by the telemetry root endpoint. Documentation URLs are null when docs are disabled for the environment.
